title: She Started a Vending Route
member_role: Home builder sales rep and stay-at-home mom, Orlando FL
excerpt: A couple who moved cross-country with no plan built a family vending route to seven locations and a $14,500 best month while both still worked day jobs.
quote: If there's any part of you that wants to have your own business — or specifically vending — you've got no reason not to do it. If you do the work, you ain't going to fail; it's going to work out.
body:
## Background
John and Lauren Sanchez moved from San Diego to Florida in June 2024 with, in John's words, "nothing really promised to us." John held a real estate license and had previously run a personal training business; a remote sales job he took after the move fizzled out, and he now works full-time in sales for a home builder. Lauren stays home with their two-year-old. It became a family effort: John's father-in-law handles financing and his sister-in-law does the books. The connection to Vendingpreneurs came through Lauren's sister, who played college lacrosse at Oregon under Mike Hoffman's wife.

> "We didn't really have anything promised to us when we moved out here."

## The Challenge
After the move, their savings started running down and John's remote sales job didn't work out. The idea of a vending business sat untouched for months while the family just talked about it.

> "We had some savings saved up, and by the end of the year we were at a point — we're like, 'Shoot, this savings, man, we got to do something here.'"

## The Turning Point
In January 2025, John decided he had to act, and started doing lead generation and pop-ins in earnest. Their first contract came about a month later.

> "I really felt compelled — I got to put my hand to this, I want to get involved with this. So January 2025 I really started to do a lot of the lead generation, a lot of the pop-ins, and we got our first contract like a month later, in February 2025."

## Where They Are Now
The Sanchezes now run seven locations, with their best month (April) bringing in about $14,500, averaging roughly $2,000 per location. John still works four days a week at his day job and stocks the route around it, alongside Lauren. Their goal is 10-plus locations and about $30,000 a month within a year.
